scope: Source facts supporting manual, approximate searchable extents; no assertion of legally current whole-quarter accuracy.

facts.fact: The municipal healthcare ordinance places the two named western neighbourhoods on the western side of the Balaton/Sándor/Szent István street boundary. This is supporting location evidence, not an individual quarter boundary.
Municipal heritage rule identifies the Csajdakert park/bath complex by Kossuth, Csajda, Zöldfa and Hősök streets. The source cites parcels1479/13 and1479/14.
Municipal tourism description identifies Érsekkert as the historical park at Érsekkert út1; park name and mapped landuse are appropriate identity evidence.
Municipal planning study describes the estate using Pataji, Kossuth Lajos, Gombolyagi and Zrínyi streets. Reconstruct coarsely from actual street geometry rather than a point radius.
The source locates Homokgyőr north-east of Gombolyagi út and references the railway as a boundary. Other closure segments remain estimates.

Indexed municipal ITS text places Tabán and Kálvária in the central action area and refers to Sóház/Ady Endre streets. The binary endpoint returned403 to the web connector, so exact map boundaries are not claimed.

webAcquisitionNote: Public sources were searched/read using the connected web tool. Binary download is centrally managed by the parent agent; blocked sources are leads, not evidence of source absence.
